info.title: Pagespeedfy
info.summary: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to measure pages with PageSpeed Insights and track their improvement history.
info.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to measure pages with PageSpeed Insights and track their improvement history. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "pagespeedfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.

command.name: pagespeedfy
command.description: CLI, TUI and MCP stdio server to measure pages with PageSpeed Insights and track their improvement history.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help for the current command and exit with code 0.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version and exit with code 0.

options.name: --json
options.description: Return JSON output with the envelope { ok, command, data } or { ok, command, error }. Errors are JSON too.

options.name: --skill
options.description: Print the full documentation embedded in the binary, written for AI agents. With a topic, print only that section.

options.name: --opencli
options.description: Print the OpenCLI description (JSON) of the whole command tree.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors in text output. Same as NO_COLOR=1.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Measure ONE page with PageSpeed Insights and record it in the project history.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Full public URL of the page (http or https).

options.name: --strategy
options.description: Strategy to measure.

options.name: --category
options.description: Comma-separated categories (performance, accessibility, best-practices, seo). Default: all.

options.name: --samples
options.description: Readings per strategy; the median is recorded (1 to 9).

options.name: --note
options.description: What changed before this measurement, shown in the history timeline.

options.name: --fail-under
options.description: Minimum scores, e.g. performance=90,seo=95 (a bare number applies to every category). Exit code 10 when any is below.

options.name: --locale
options.description: Language of the audit texts.

options.name: --max-items
options.description: Detail items kept per failed audit.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum time per API query.

options.name: --retries
options.description: Attempts per query on HTTP 429 and 5xx.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project root that holds .pagespeedfy/ (history.db and raw reports). Default: PAGESPEEDFY_PROJECT, then the nearest folder with .pagespeedfy/, .git or package.json.

exitCodes.description: SUCCESS: Operation completed.
GENERIC_ERROR: Unexpected failure without a specific classification.
USAGE: Invalid arguments, options or subcommand.
CONFIG: settings.json missing, invalid or unknown key.
CREDENTIALS: credentials.json unreadable, master key missing or credential not found.
NETWORK_OR_API: Network failure or unexpected API response.
PERMISSION: Permission denied on the file system.
BUDGET: A score fell below the --fail-under budget, or compare found a regression with --fail-on-regression.
